title: Your 401k Default Fund Is Draining $127K From You
hook: Your employer auto-enrolled you in a 'safe' default fund — 72% of workers never change it, and that one oversight quietly destroys $127,000 in retirement money.
angle: Target date funds (the default in most 401ks) charge 0.5–0.8% vs. index funds at 0.03%. Over 25 years on $300K that fee gap = $127K gone. Plus bonds added early cost another $40K in growth.
audience: Working adults 25–55 with a 401k they've never actively managed
key_numbers: 72% of auto-enrolled workers never change the default fund
